venus.guide.welcome: You reached Venus. Keep your suit and supplies: unprotected exposure is lethal. Click here or use /venus to start the guide.
venus.guide.complete: Colony established. Check supplies, maintenance and expeditions with the navigator.
venus.guide.commands: /venus guia: all steps · /venus recursos 15 2 75: supplies for minutes, occupants and volume. K: recipes.
venus.guide.safety: Keep a Venus suit, oxygen and cooling. An empty room is unsafe: it needs a seal, operating controller and supplies. The guide grants no protection.
venus.guide.shelter.detail: Seal a room with rated panels and an airlock. Supply O₂, power and water. Enter and check pressure. K shows recipes.
venus.guide.power.detail: Place a generator above lava. Add an empty cell and water; finish a batch. Since 0.41 water is returned. Observe within 16 blocks.
venus.guide.cooling.detail: Chill water with power. Charge the exchanger with chilled coolant and another cell, beside the controller. Observe its reserve within 16 blocks.
venus.guide.automation.detail: Point an interface at a machine. Add carriers and separate supplied tank networks. Observe within 16 blocks when its supply status is working.
venus.guide.food.detail: In an operating room with light 9+: seed, cell and water. Finish wheat and observe before changing recipes. Reuse the seed and carriers.
venus.guide.expedition.detail: Repair natural equipment to 70%, finish a batch and load a report, cell and data card into its console. Sneak-use empty-handed to claim. See /expediciones.

colossus.quest.intro: Expedition: Signal of the Colossus. While standing on the ground, sneak-use the research log on a solid block at each natural site. Progress is personal.
colossus.quest.objective_0: Recover the emergency log at the Abandoned Venus Foundry.
colossus.quest.objective_1: Decode the log at the Venus Ash Outpost.
colossus.quest.objective_2: Examine the Sulfurfire Nest to triangulate the signal.
colossus.quest.objective_3: Read the coordinates in your log and explore the Colossus Bunker.
colossus.quest.objective_4: Defeat the Sulfur Colossus inside the bunker.
colossus.quest.objective_5: Expedition complete: the Colossus signal has fallen silent.
colossus.quest.detail_0: Abandoned foundry: the emergency log describes a heat signal unrelated to any machine. Recover the records using your log.
colossus.quest.detail_1: Ash outpost: records identify a basalt organism whose emissions match the Sulfurfire Nest. Decode the log here.
colossus.quest.detail_2: Sulfurfire Nest: roots carry pulses from a deep chamber. Examine them with the log to calculate the bunker coordinates.
colossus.quest.detail_3: Bunker: reach the chamber and examine a block using your log. Bring a Venus or abyssal suit, armor, lighting and supplies; the chamber is not pressurized.
colossus.quest.detail_4: Colossus: dodge eruption marks and attack while the core opens. The kill must be credited to you; other explorers have separate progress.
colossus.quest.coordinates: Venus destination — Colossus Bunker: %s. Coordinates saved in your log.
colossus.quest.survey: Triangulation in progress. The search continues incrementally while you are on Venus. Use /venus coloso to check or resume it.
colossus.quest.unavailable: Bunker search unavailable: check that structures and their configuration are enabled.
colossus.quest.not_found: No valid bunker found in the surveyed area. Travel to another region and use /venus coloso to retry.

mars.guide.title: Mars · First shelter
mars.guide.arrival.detail: Travel to Mars by rocket and wait for touchdown. Teleporting does not start the expedition.
mars.guide.welcome: Touchdown complete. Mars expedition started. Click to open the animated guide.
mars.guide.select: Right-click a habitat controller to select your shelter.
mars.guide.selected: Selected Mars shelter: %s. Open another controller to change it before completion.
mars.guide.seal_hint: Close walls, roof and door; keep the controller vent clear.
mars.guide.supply_hint: Operating controller: at least 600 O₂ and 1500 power.
mars.guide.water_hint: Store 2 water canisters in the controller’s third slot.
mars.guide.inside: Enter the sealed room to validate all objectives together.
mars.guide.next: Next expedition: investigate a Martian settlement. Open /marte expedicion.
mars.guide.safety: Keep your suit and its oxygen supplied during construction. The mission grants no atmospheric protection; only an operating habitat protects its room.
mars.guide.refuge.detail: Build or restore a room and right-click its habitat controller. Existing bases work too. Selecting a controller only binds the base; it does not prove it works.
mars.guide.sealed.detail: Example: 7×7×5 outer shell, 5×5×3 interior. Full blocks work on Mars. Close floor, walls, roof and airlock; keep air above the controller. Maximum 512 air blocks, radius 12. Airlocks need redstone; use two doors to avoid venting.
mars.guide.supplies.detail: Controller top row: oxygen on the left, charged power cell in the middle. Wait for the containers to be consumed and the protected status. Keep ≥600 O₂ and ≥1500 power: five minutes for two occupants, without leaks.
mars.guide.water.detail: Store 2 full water canisters in the third top-row slot. Mars does not consume them as coolant. Water emptied into industrial tanks inside the same room also counts, totaling 2000 units. Carried water or another base does not count.
mars.guide.packing: Before travel: controller, full blocks, airlock and levers, suit oxygen, at least 2 oxygen canisters, 2 charged cells and 2 water canisters for the base. Spare oxygen and power cover reopening the room. Electrolyzer and solar charger are optional for resupply.
mars.guide.recipes.controller: Controller (crafting): HCH / ROG / HCH. H=pressure hull, C=copper, R=redstone, O=observer, G=glass. Hull: ICI / CIC → 8; I=iron, C=copper.
mars.guide.recipes.power: Empty power cell: ICI / IRI → 2; I=iron, C=copper, R=redstone. Charge it by crafting with 2 redstone + 1 copper. No Venus technology or solar charger is needed.
mars.guide.recipes.water: Empty canister: iron cross around glass → 4. Empty canister + water bucket → water canister, bucket returned. Electrolyzer: water + charged cell + empty canister → oxygen + hydrogen in 10 s.
mars.guide.recipes.electrolyzer: Electrolyzer: HCH / WRW / HCH. H=pressure hull, C=copper, W=water bucket, R=redstone. Inputs: slots 1/2/3; outputs: 4/5/6. Ice + charged cell + empty canister → water in 5 s. Clear outputs to keep it working.
mars.guide.recipes.browser: The recipe viewer shows actual crafting grids and machine processes. Check its keys in Options → Controls → Space Fabric. /marte shows progress and shelter coordinates.
mars.tutorial.title: Mars training console
mars.tutorial.controls: ← → chapters · Space pause · R replay · 1–8 select · Tab / Enter controls · Esc close
mars.tutorial.update_client: The animated guide needs Space Fabric 0.59.0 on your client. /marte texto keeps the written guide.
mars.tutorial.pack.title: Prepare the expedition
mars.tutorial.pack.caption: Base equipment. Panels are an example: ordinary solid blocks work too. Bring a rocket, suit, personal oxygen and food. The second oxygen canister and battery provide a reserve.
mars.tutorial.build.title: Build the shelter
mars.tutorial.build.caption: Build a complete floor, walls and roof. The shell is shown closed before a section is removed to reveal the interior. Your real shelter must remain enclosed.
mars.tutorial.cutaway: TEACHING CUT · Seal your real base
mars.tutorial.vent.title: Place the controller
mars.tutorial.vent.caption: Inside, on the floor, with air immediately above. Right-click the controller to select this shelter. Registering it does not yet prove it is operational.
mars.tutorial.airlock.title: Close the airlocks
mars.tutorial.airlock.caption: Two doors in series with an enclosed vestibule. Use levers: enter, close the outer door, then open the inner one. The roof and near wall are hidden only for teaching.
mars.tutorial.airlock.enter: 01 · Open the outer door and enter
mars.tutorial.airlock.exit: 03 · Open the inner door and enter
mars.tutorial.supplies.title: Supply oxygen and power
mars.tutorial.supplies.caption: Top row: oxygen in slot 1 and battery in slot 2. Wait for processing. Empty battery returns to slot 6; canister to slot 7. Required: 600 oxygen and 1500 energy.
mars.tutorial.supplies.scene: Top row · O₂ / power cell / water
mars.tutorial.water.title: Store the water reserve
mars.tutorial.water.caption: Store two full canisters in slot 3, at the top right. On Mars they remain stored, providing 2000 units. Water in your own inventory does not count.
mars.tutorial.example: Animated example · Uses none of your items
mars.tutorial.recipes.title: Craft the components
mars.tutorial.recipes.caption: Select a component. Grids and products come from your server, including datapacks. Hover over items for names. Arrows change the recipe variant.
mars.tutorial.unavailable: Recipe unavailable. Select an item again to retry.
mars.tutorial.no_recipe: This item has no recipe available on the server.
mars.tutorial.finish.title: Validate your shelter
mars.tutorial.finish.caption: After a real landing, enter your sealed, pressurized, supplied shelter. The server requires everything at once. The next objective is to investigate a Martian settlement.
mars.tutorial.safety: The guide pauses a local game. On a server, the world keeps running: open it from a safe place.
mars.tutorial.water.label: Water
mars.tutorial.airlock.done: 04 · Close it to preserve the seal
mars.tutorial.pack.phase.help: Base kit: 1 controller, 2 airlocks, 192 blocks, 4 levers; 2 oxygen, 2 batteries, 2 water. Bring a suit and personal oxygen.
mars.tutorial.build.floor.help: Build a complete 7×7 floor. Pressure panels are optional: ordinary solid blocks work too.
mars.tutorial.build.walls.help: Build three-block-high walls. Leave the airlock entrance and close every other gap.
mars.tutorial.build.roof.help: Close the entire roof. Exterior 7×7×5; interior 5×5×3. An open roof cannot seal the room.
mars.tutorial.build.sealed.help: The shell is now enclosed. Your real shelter must be fully closed like this, including its doors.
mars.tutorial.build.cut.help: We remove the roof and walls ONLY to reveal the interior. Keep them closed in your world.
mars.tutorial.vent.place.help: Place the controller inside, on the floor. The shelter must be completely enclosed.
mars.tutorial.vent.air.help: Leave a block of air immediately above the controller. Blocking its intake prevents seal detection.
mars.tutorial.vent.select.help: Right-click the controller to choose your shelter. Registering it does not yet prove it works.
mars.tutorial.airlock.enter.help: Open the outer door with a lever and enter the vestibule. Keep the inner door closed.
mars.tutorial.airlock.close.help: Inside the vestibule, close the outer door before opening the inner one. Both are now closed.
mars.tutorial.airlock.exit.help: Open the inner door and enter the shelter. The outer door remains closed, preventing exposure.
mars.tutorial.airlock.done.help: Close the inner door. The roof and near wall are hidden only for teaching: enclose your real vestibule.
mars.tutorial.supplies.insert.help: Top row: oxygen in 1, battery in 2. This animation uses no items; do this in your real controller.
mars.tutorial.supplies.wait.help: Wait for consumption and pressurization. You need at least 600 internal oxygen and 1500 energy.
mars.tutorial.supplies.processed.help: Example: 2251 oxygen, 2395 energy after one cycle. Empty battery returns to slot 6, canister to slot 7.
mars.tutorial.water.slot.help: Put two water canisters in slot 3, at the top right. Water in your inventory does not count.
mars.tutorial.water.stored.help: 2 canisters = 2000 units. On Mars they stay stored in the controller instead of being used as coolant.
mars.tutorial.recipes.phase.help: Select an icon for server recipes. Arrows change variants. Hover over ingredients to see their names.
mars.tutorial.finish.inside.help: Land for real and enter your sealed base. It needs 600 oxygen, 1500 energy and 2000 water simultaneously.
mars.tutorial.finish.next.help: The server validates your real shelter, then unlocks investigating a Martian settlement. This demonstration completes no missions.
mars.settlement.title: Expedition II · Settlement
mars.settlement.locked: Complete the first expedition and return to Mars wearing your suit. Use /marte.
mars.settlement.stage_0: Find and enter a natural Martian Village.
mars.settlement.stage_1: Look at a solid village block and use /marte investigar.
mars.settlement.stage_2: Look at an analyzer with empty inputs and use /marte analizar.
mars.settlement.stage_3: Commission active: process a Martian sample in your analyzer.
mars.settlement.stage_4: Return to the survey point and use /marte entregar.
mars.settlement.stage_5: Research registered. Next objective: a self-sufficient base.
mars.settlement.help_0: After completing the shelter, find a Martian Village. /marte buscar locates nearby natural villages in loaded chunks. Otherwise it suggests an UNCONFIRMED potential region: explore it and search again. Only entering a real structure advances this expedition.
mars.settlement.help_1: Inside the village, look at a solid block within 5 blocks and use /marte investigar. This becomes your registration point; keep its coordinates. No living NPC is required. If the block disappears, register another in the SAME village with that command.
mars.settlement.help_2: Craft the existing analyzer. On Mars, look at it with all three input slots empty and use /marte analizar BEFORE loading it. One active commission per machine; each player needs their own cycle. If it breaks or you want to change it: /marte cancelar, then bind another.
mars.settlement.help_3: Analyzer top row: 1 Martian olivine OR sulfate dust, 1 charged battery, 1 data card. Wait for 10 seconds of real work with free output space. It produces a report and returns an empty battery. You keep the report; an old report does not prove this commission.
mars.settlement.help_4: Return to the same village and look at your registered block. /marte entregar records the research and awards 2 charged batteries once. Leave a regular slot or space for two batteries in one stack. A full inventory keeps the delivery pending; your report is not consumed.
mars.settlement.help_5: Personal progress survives reconnections. Players may share a village and survey point, but commission separate analyses. The next stage will secure base self-sufficiency. This release only announces that objective. The guide displays real server progress.
mars.settlement.visited: Natural village discovered. Look at a solid village block and use /marte investigar.
mars.settlement.look_point: Enter your Martian Village and look at a solid block within its buildings. Use /marte investigar to register the point.
mars.settlement.point: Survey point: %s. You may register another block in the same village if needed.
mars.settlement.bind_order: Survey a village point first. If a commission is already active, use /marte cancelar before switching analyzers.
mars.settlement.look_analyzer: Look at a nearby analyzer on Mars and use /marte analizar.
mars.settlement.busy: That analyzer has another active commission. Use another machine or wait for completion.
mars.settlement.empty_analyzer: Empty all three inputs and wait until the analyzer is idle and repaired before binding it.
mars.settlement.bound: Commissioned analyzer: %s. Now load the sample, battery and data card.
mars.settlement.analyzed: Martian analysis completed and credited. Return to your survey point and use /marte entregar.
mars.settlement.cancelled: Commission cancelled. Your survey progress remains; bind another empty analyzer.
mars.settlement.delivery_order: The server has not credited your analysis cycle yet. Use /marte expedicion.
mars.settlement.return_point: Look at your registered village block to deliver. Use /marte for its coordinates.
mars.settlement.inventory_full: Leave a regular slot or room for two charged batteries in one stack. Your research remains pending.
mars.settlement.completed: Settlement research registered. One-time reward: 2 charged batteries.
mars.settlement.next: Next narrative objective: make your shelter self-sufficient. This third stage is not implemented yet.
mars.settlement.found: Natural village confirmed in loaded terrain: %s.
mars.settlement.potential: UNCONFIRMED potential region: X %s, Z %s. It may lack a village; explore and repeat /marte buscar. No chunks were loaded or generated.
mars.settlement.not_found: No confirmed villages nearby. Explore another area of Mars and use /marte buscar again.
mars.settlement.search_wait: Wait five seconds of game time before searching again.
mars.autonomy.locked: Self-sufficiency locked: finish and register the settlement investigation.
mars.autonomy.available: Self-sufficiency available: use /marte autonomia iniciar to accept.
mars.autonomy.accepted: Self-sufficiency accepted. Selecting a shelter is the next step and will arrive in a later release.
